name: Meta Agents Research Environments (ARE)
summary: MIT research platform from Meta for simulating dynamic, multi-step agent tasks, including official Gaia2 evaluation.
description: Established Meta project (repo facebookresearch/meta-agents-research-environments; not archived; created 2025-09-11; last pushed 2026-09-30; not presented as a brand-new 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is MIT (Copyright Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates). Vendor: Meta. PyPI meta-agents-research-environments 1.2.0 verified 2026-11-13 (not yanked; files uploaded 2025-11-11; project URLs point at this repository). There were no GitHub Releases on 2026-11-13; because the repo has been pushed since that PyPI upload, this entry notes that the 1.2.0 wheels may lag main. README install is pip install meta-agents-research-environments (optional [gui] extra). Docs at https://facebookresearch.github.io/meta-agents-research-environments/ and the Gaia2 evaluation guide (both HTTP 200). README describes evolving simulated environments, multi-step tasks, and official Gaia2 evaluation (800 scenarios). A container-based Gaia2-CLI stack lives under gaia2-cli/. Simulated apps can include write actions (mail, contacts, and similar in-sim tools). Model-API and compute costs for evaluations are separate; no keys or benchmark runs were used.

agent_access.notes: Python package: pip install meta-agents-research-environments (PyPI 1.2.0 as of 2026-11-13). Official Gaia2 runs also need the Hugging Face dataset. No API keys were used.
